This petition is filed by the Petitioners against Respondent No.1 to 6 under Sec.166 of M.V.Act 1994 for the relief of compensation.

2. The brief facts of the case is as under; That on 12.04.2021 at about 11.45 p.m. Derangula Peddanna @ D. Peddanna was proceeding in a Lorry bearing Reg. No.AP-02-TE-2457 as cleaner being driven by its driver by name Mahesh on Tumkur-Maddur NH-33 SCCH 5 Road, near Kadamba Family Daba, Huliyurdurga Town, while so proceeding the driver of the said lorry has dashed the lorry against the already stationed/parked lorry bearing Reg. No.AP-39-W-6556 which was parked by its driver without switching on the side indicator nor following any of the traffic rules and regulations, consequent to which, driver sustained injuries, thereafter 108 ambulance came to the spot and driver of the lorry bearing Reg. No.AP-02-TE-2457 has taken treatment as the injuries is simple in nature.
Thereafter Huliyurdurga Police staff along with A.S.I. Shivakumar came to the accident spot and enquiring regarding accident by standing on extreme left side of the road.

On 13.04.2021 at about 12.20 a.m. suddenly a driver of the lorry bearing Reg. No.GJ-1-C-1810 loaded with pipes came from behind from Maddur towards Kunigal side in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against lorry bearing Reg.

Ofcourse in the rulings of respondent No.4, their lordships have held the following principles;
a) If any persons make false claim under M.V.Act before the tribunals, the tribunals have power to recall its own orders b) Incase respondents have submits no objections to allow claim petitions under M.V.Act, it clearly indicates to the court that, it is clear admissions SCCH 5 to pay the compensation to the claimants from Insurance Company, though tribunals have got powers to dismiss the petition etc.,
c) If the medical evidence indicates to the tribunals that, deceased was suffered injury due to fall in his own house, then he is not entitled for relief etc.,
